known_defects: Primary 21-frame capture (evidence/v1) is missing the 'frame 0 at 0ms' header and the top 8 lines: 21 frames x 48 lines = 1008 lines, but `herdr pane read` returned 1000 lines, so the cycle proof starts inside frame 0 and runs to frame 20 at 3000ms. The same spec was captured again as evidence/v1-origin with --frames 4, which preserves frame 0 and shows all six dots at their origins; check.txt independently reports origins: 6/6.
The shell prompt of the closed pane appears after the last frame in evidence/v1/v1-frames.txt (harness artifact of the pane read, not renderer output).
e1 (cli->api) and e4 (queue->worker) carry no label, because the source calls them unlabeled historical relations. A reviewer sees two unannotated arrows; labelling them would invent a protocol.

The renderer's own composition leaves rows 2-6 of the 47-row pane empty above CLI; the graph occupies rows 7-37 with the control palette clear at bottom-left. Not a fit failure, but the field is not evenly filled.

Candidate-skill/binary gap: the skill documents a top-level "duration_ms" for shared animation time, but the frozen binary rejects it (unknown field duration_ms; expected direction, theme, nodes, layers, edges, trunks). The rate had to be put on every edge instead; an agent following the skill literally hits a hard spec rejection.

Router limitation observed: with explicit `layers` plus the auth->db edge, the frozen binary failed with 'no obstacle-safe route for worker -> db; increase node/layer spacing'. The same six relations route cleanly once explicit layers are dropped and sugiyama places the nodes. No spec-level control exists to add the spacing the error asks for.
No color-blind check was done; group shades were verified only as RGB values from the ANSI capture (control pink family #e29caf / #d3869b, others distinct).
The round-03 independent review step was not run (the task forbids spawning a judge; the captain runs the Sol judge).
